name: Kogishiro Shizuka
source: The former No.1 girl of the brothel "Honey Bee". She genuinely likes her job as a prostitute and always makes sure to give her best service to her customers. However, nowadays she hasn't been requested much as the shop's customers prefer the younger girls. Despite that, she still continues to earnestly work as a prostitute.
